controls.title: Buyer, supplier, admin, billing, verification and private-document flows are reproducible
controls.notes: Authenticated HTTP smoke, migration, seed, container build and dependency audit passed on main c3f6fec5. Re-verify on the launch commit.

controls.title: Controlled Beta access, kill switch, demo-only data policy and noindex are enforced server-side
controls.notes: Complete the full Node 22 gate, merge through CI and record the merge SHA before changing this control to done.

controls.title: The Beta database is migrated, seeded with demo-only data and persists across restart
controls.notes: Select or provide a PostgreSQL Beta environment and DATABASE_URL secret, then run migration/seed, restart and persistence readback.

controls.title: An immutable application image is deployed at an external HTTPS provider URL
controls.notes: No GitHub Environment, deployment, runtime secret or existing hosting provider is configured. Connect one container-capable Beta target and inject the documented runtime values.

controls.title: A clean external client verifies TLS, health, catalog, authentication and protected routes
controls.notes: Run only after beta-deployment has a real provider URL; attach timestamp, commit/image digest and happy plus forbidden-path evidence.

controls.title: A debug APK built from the launch commit is available as a CI or release artifact
controls.notes: Build and attach the debug APK after the external Beta URL is known; do not create a production signing key.

controls.title: Main SHA, image digest, migration, SBOM, tag and prerelease notes identify one launch candidate
controls.notes: Create the prerelease tag and GitHub Release only after merge, deployment and external smoke are successful.

controls.title: Rollback, monitoring access and the Beta kill-switch procedure are verified
controls.notes: Record the previous image digest, execute a rollback rehearsal, verify BETA_ENABLED=false and document the observation window.
